skill_card.name: Coverage Analyzer
skill_card.description: Analyzes evidence-based test coverage and identifies actionable gaps by comparing traceable test cases against requirements, validation rules, and API contracts to produce quantitative coverage metrics.

tasks.name: Aggregate explicit traceability linkages
tasks.description: Maps requirement IDs, validation rules, and API contracts directly to linked test case IDs.
tasks.input_schema: Requirements model, test design cases, and optional API contract outputs.
tasks.output_schema: Structured coverage details mapping source IDs to test IDs.

tasks.name: Compute quantitative coverage metrics
tasks.description: Calculates percentage coverage across requirements, acceptance criteria, and validation dimensions.
tasks.input_schema: Coverage mapping details and coverage threshold settings.

tasks.name: Generate actionable gaps report
tasks.description: Detects uncovered requirement items, orphaned test links, and unlinked test cases into deterministic gap entries.
tasks.output_schema: Actionable gaps report and missing evidence diagnostics.
